title: The gift trade (trade_offer / trade_accept relay)
oneLine: One in-memory single-shot gift offer per sender>target, validated and settled at accept, swept at 120 s.
topConcern: Gift lane never got trade2's v2.3.3183 fight lock: a modified phone losing a PvP fight gifts its bag to a friend, emptying the killer's pile.

title: The two-sided trade window (trade2 session)
oneLine: In-memory session: invite, offer stage, review stage, confirms, commit; staged weapons escrowed in trade2wpn: rows.
topConcern: Weapon deliveries are awaited after the one-write commit; a restart between them lets the join sweep refund the weapons while gold/items already moved.

title: The order book's order (mkt_order: rest, match, cancel, expire)
oneLine: Escrowed buy/sell orders in the GameRoom's bucket book, settled credit-first, converged by settle/refund stamps at wake.
topConcern: A crossing placement is four write batches; a restart can drop the taker's escrow, or the rebuild deletes a half-settled order unpaid.

title: A credit's life: live, parked in the mailbox, drained at the join (inbox + oplog)
oneLine: The one payout funnel: in-flight set, 48 h oplog stamps, per-box serial chain, join drain, paged prune job.
topConcern: Idempotency is a 48 h journal while store listings (7 d) and market orders converge on it lazily; leftovers converged late go the wrong way.

title: An Auction House listing (store_listing: rest, bid, sale, release)
oneLine: Listing record with sale/pendBid/pendOffer/releasing intent markers, converged by oplog reads at a lazy wake rebuild.
topConcern: Item listings take the stack in one batch and write the record in the next; a restart between leaves goods gone with nothing naming them.

title: An escrowed offer on a listing
oneLine: A buyer's gold escrowed against a listing: pending, live, think, accepted, refunded or expired after 48 h.
topConcern: The offer-expiry pass counts every record and stops at the first 20 with no cursor, so offers on later listings never expire in 48 h.

title: A listing's haggle thread (store_thread:)
oneLine: Per-listing buyer threads created on first line and dropped at every listing end, before the record.

title: Diego's public pile (shop_stock)
oneLine: One global per-key stock count, seeded once, setting his buy price; sales save purse and pile together.

title: The bank vault (bank:<pid>, cached per session)
oneLine: Versioned vault record with a load-once cache, failed/newer states, and opId ring; moves written with the bag.

title: The gambling tables (Hall roll, Ace coin flip, Ace item wager, hall of fame)
oneLine: Single-event settles gated by in-memory per-player cooldown stamps; silent refusals; client panel's 6 s fallback.
topConcern: No fight or place gate: a modified phone can wager its bag mid-PvP-fight; client mirror of the bounds is unpinned.

title: The /roll and /flip cadence (dice)
oneLine: One in-memory 5 s stamp per player; the roll is a placed event; pinned client mirror.

title: A mystery piece in the bag (unrevealed to revealed)
oneLine: Server-owned unrevealed mark on every server copy of a piece, cleared by reveal, wear or join.
topConcern: Seven writers across six files; trade/market/store/salvage doors deliberately ignore the mark and ship the grade to the other party.

title: Salvage and the grade ladder (normal to godly)
oneLine: A piece's quality raised only by a same-metal essence; salvage turns it into bars; 250 ms per-player stamp.

title: The wooden-greatsword conversion (old to metal)
oneLine: Idempotent rewrite of weapon blobs by migration v20 plus heals at the post and the shelves' rebuilds.

title: A score checkpoint on the chain (sign, nonce, broadcast, receipt)
oneLine: Attestation pipeline with a bounded receipt poll; the in-flight lane and DO-wide queue live in chainscore.js.

title: The old global Marketplace DO's order book
oneLine: Unsettled bucket book kept only for its wrangler binding; nothing routes to it.

title: Once-a-character prize marks (aponce:<pid>)
oneLine: Marks read at join before the mail, written with the points in the blob's save, fail closed when unread.
